bibl.title: Emperor Meets Gods: Divine Discourse in Greek Papyri from Roman Egypt.
bibl.seg: Janneke de Jong, Emperor Meets Gods: Divine Discourse in Greek Papyri from Roman Egypt.
Maijastina Kahlos (ed.), Emperors and the Divine - Rome and its Influence = COLLeGIUM. Studies across Disciplines in the Humanities and Social Sciences. 20 (Helsinki, 2016) pp. 22-55, figg.
bibl.note: Introduction: imperial and divine discourse. - Emperors as gods: some examples. - Imperial divinity expressed in titulature in Greek papyri from the Roman period. - Emperors as gods in oaths. - Son of a god: imperial deification. - Conclusion. - Appendix: oath formulas in papyri from the reign of Augustus.
